name: List
description: A vertical item list with leading and trailing slots, secondary text, and a dense mode.
usage:
<List>
  <ListItem leading={<Folder />} title="Reports" secondary="12 files" trailing="2 GB" />
  <ListItem title="Archive" onClick={() => undefined} />
</List>

anatomy.description: An icon or avatar rendered before the text at a fixed width.
A semibold title with an optional muted secondary line; both truncate.
Metadata or an action pinned to the end of the row.
A hairline-separated li that becomes a full-width button when onClick is set.

dos: Use onClick rows instead of small inline buttons so the whole row is the target.
Switch on dense in side panels and other space-tight contexts.
Keep secondary text to one short line; it truncates beyond that.
donts: Don't nest additional interactive elements inside an onClick row.
Don't use List for site navigation; use a navigation component with a nav landmark.

examples.title: Slots and actions
examples.description: onClick turns the row into a button; dense tightens every item.

examples.title: Dense actions
examples.description: A dense list of clickable rows for compact file or settings pickers.

examples.title: Dense lists
examples.description: Use dense inside popovers and panels where vertical space is tight.

guidance.useWhen: A vertical set of items carries icons, secondary text, or trailing metadata, like files or settings entries.
guidance.avoidWhen: The items are navigation; use a navigation component. Records needing columns fit Table better.
guidance.behavior: onClick turns the whole row into a button; dense reduces the vertical padding of every item.
guidance.responsive: Titles and secondary text truncate while leading and trailing slots stay pinned.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the rows that have an onClick handler.

notes: Rows with onClick render real button elements inside each list item; static rows stay non-interactive.
Titles and secondary text truncate visually, but the full text remains available to screen readers.

props.description: Reduces the vertical padding of every item.
props.name: dense

props.description: Content rendered before the text, e.g. an icon or avatar.
props.name: leading

props.description: Called when the item is activated; makes the item a button.
props.name: onClick

props.description: Supporting text rendered under the title.
props.name: secondary

props.description: Content rendered after the text, e.g. metadata or an action.
